conclusion: Suitable for a preliminary offline pretrained SmolVLA fine-tuning experiment after explicit quality-aware sampling, episode-level train/validation split, dataset integration and 8D preprocessing configuration. Not certified for robot deployment.

data.definition: Valid current observation and action, full future valid action chunk within same episode. Original indices retained; no training sampler created; sensor physical synchronization and online causality not certified.

model_compatibility.scope: Real data forward/loss and inference only; no backward, optimizer step, weight save, or robot call. Does not establish training convergence or task success.
model_compatibility.normalization_note: Each diagnostic batch uses its own dataset statistics. A combined experiment needs statistics fitted only on the chosen training split.

remaining_preparation: Use explicit camera feature mapping and 8D state/action; fit normalization using training episodes only.
Integrate the three separate v3 datasets with session-aware episode identity; do not naively concatenate metadata or reuse the six-dimensional synthetic smoke config.
Preserve original timelines; select valid current observation/action anchors with complete within-episode future action windows. Proposed eligibility counts are before validation split.
Split by complete original episode, e.g. 32 training and 7 held-out episodes distributed across all three sessions; do not random-split correlated frames.
First check overfitting and loss on a few clean episodes, then expand to selected training episodes; stop or revise if validation degrades.

code_observation.implication: Do not rely on current default loss to mask padded tail actions without confirming mapping. Initial assessment counts only complete unpadded action windows, avoiding this mismatch.

limitations: 415 frames use flagged nominal clock mapping; clock mapping and sensor exposure synchronization are not equivalent.
Surround camera source-to-receive difference is around 0.39 s; source-nearest observations are not verified online-causal observations. Physical delay not calibrated.
Single task language and repeated scene; cannot infer language-conditioned selection or unseen-scene generalization.
No backward pass, optimizer update, learning curve, held-out performance, or robot task success tested in this assessment.
Measured forward GPU peak about 1.28 GiB reserved is not training memory requirement. GPU currently has about 8.4 GiB free; start small batch and measure rather than assuming fit.

suggested_initial_experiment.first_stage: 3–5 clock-clean episodes; 200–500 steps as a diagnostic proposal, not a convergence guarantee
suggested_initial_experiment.second_stage: episode-level 32/7 train-validation split; initial 2000–5000 step budget adjusted to validation
